evolving-populations-beaks.alt: Bar chart of beak depth in an invented seed-eating bird. Parents before a drought: 10% at 8 mm, 25% at 9 mm, 35% at 10 mm, 20% at 11 mm, 10% at 12 mm. Offspring after the drought: 4% at 8 mm, 15% at 9 mm, 32% at 10 mm, 30% at 11 mm, 19% at 12 mm. The distribution shifts toward deeper beaks.
